about: Autonomy table for an agent you build. Each act: alone (runs without a human), ask (waits for an owner's yes), never (refused). Acts not listed ask. Check with: node tools/policy.mjs templates/policy.json <act> [--guessed]

comment.why: an acknowledgement on the issue that asked; easy to edit or delete

open_pr.why: others review it and CI spends money

change_contract.why: an API answer others depend on changes; needs a decision record and the owner

rotate_secret.why: breaks running services; an owner does it by hand
